words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes the closing question follow as the immediate consequence of the destruction just narrated. The particle does not let the ayah begin as an isolated observation; it says, in effect, after that devastation, now inspect what remains. Its bound, one-letter form fuses the transition directly onto {{ar:هَلْ}} ({{tr:hal}}), so the move from report to challenge is both grammatically compressed and audible.

topics.reason: QAC identifies the particle as a resumptive or consequential connector, and the clause evidence ties the question to the preceding destruction account.

words.prose: {{ar:هَلْ}} ({{tr:hal}}) gives the ayah its search form: the clause asks whether the addressee sees, but the destruction context makes the expected answer no. That visible question form matters because it turns denial into verification; the reader is made to test the aftermath rather than merely receive a statement. It also supplies the scope in which {{ar:مِنْ بَاقِيَةٍ}} ({{tr:min bāqiyatin}}) can mean not even one remnant, while the independent particle stands between the opening connector and the verb as the hinge of the challenge. Its clipped stop gives a small recited hinge before the longer seeing verb opens the search.

topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the question as rhetorical with negative force, not a neutral request for information.

words.prose: {{ar:تَرَىٰ}} ({{tr:tarā}}) is the ayah's verbal engine: an imperfect second-person perception verb that makes the addressee inspect the aftermath in the present. Its usual object slot is not filled by a direct noun; instead the search is routed through {{ar:مِنْ بَاقِيَةٍ}} ({{tr:min bāqiyatin}}), so the missing object becomes part of the proof that nothing remains. The root range allows physical sight and mental assessment, and both are locally useful, while dream-vision, causative showing, and mutual seeing are only contrasts; the local relation runs one way, from the addressed verifier toward the destroyed peoples. The long final vowel gives the act of looking a held moment before the object field collapses. The verb also repeats the seeing movement from 69:7, where sight was filled with fallen bodies, into 69:8, where sight is asked to find a remnant and fails.

words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) opens the pronoun phrase that marks whose remnant is being searched for. The phrase can be read with the verb as the domain of seeing or with the remnant as possession, but both readings keep attribution central: any survival would have to count for them. Because the particle and suffix appear before {{ar:مِنْ بَاقِيَةٍ}} ({{tr:min bāqiyatin}}), the ayah first establishes the destroyed peoples' claim or domain, then denies that anything exists in it. Its compact middle position buffers the seeing verb from the partitive phrase, and the nasal transition into what follows makes that binding audible.

words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) carries the destroyed peoples into the final question without renaming them. Its bound form makes them grammatically dependent inside {{ar:لَهُمْ}} ({{tr:lahum}}), not renewed as actors, and its plural form can gather the recent destruction sequence into one no-remnant verdict, while the nearest grammar still anchors the immediate destroyed group. The second-person verb faces this third-person reference: you inspect them, but they appear only as an absent group for whom no surviving trace can be found.

words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) turns the final noun into a searched field rather than a known object. It governs {{ar:بَاقِيَةٍ}} ({{tr:bāqiyatin}}) in the genitive and supplies the notional object of {{ar:تَرَىٰ}} ({{tr:tarā}}), but under the rhetorical force of {{ar:هَلْ}} ({{tr:hal}}) its partitive sense becomes exhaustive: not even one member of the remnant class. It remains a separate word before the indefinite noun, so the exhaustive particle is visible while its nasal texture binds into what follows. Because it comes after {{ar:لَهُمْ}} ({{tr:lahum}}), the clause first fixes whose survival is at issue and then scans for the smallest recoverable remainder.

words.prose: {{ar:بَاقِيَةٍ}} ({{tr:bāqiyatin}}) is the word on which the ayah lands: a remaining entity, survivor, trace, or residue, left indefinite so any possible instance is included. Its genitive ending keeps it under {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}), while its active-participle form makes the denied item concrete, not just abstract survival. The root image of remaining is therefore activated in order to be measured at zero. Because the head noun is unstated, the denial can cover a person, physical remnant, legacy, or ongoing trace, including even an ongoing trace of punishment, but local grammar does not turn the word into the other root branches such as sparing, reserve, or watching. Within the occurrence evidence, the active-participle form is limited but not unique, so the form is salient without being a hapax. Against permanence language elsewhere (87:17), this is not a comparative permanence term but a denied remaining entity. The final position and indefinite cadence let the question close on the very thing whose absence it proves.

topics.headline: any possible remnant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the noun is not a named survivor or known trace; its indefiniteness opens the class of any possible remnant.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify an indefinite genitive noun governed by the preposition under rhetorical negative force.

topics.headline: unstated head widens the denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the omitted head noun lets the denial include survivor, trace, entity, and legacy without forcing one narrow referent.
topics.reason: The feminine active participle can stand with an understood head, and no adjective or idafa dependent narrows it locally.

topics.headline: case and role diverge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the remnant is grammatically governed by the preposition while semantically functioning as what the seeing-test seeks.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the preposition govern the noun while the verb evidence notes the phrase as the notional object.

topics.headline: remainingness measured at zero
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the irony that the word for remaining is placed exactly where the ayah proves that nothing remains.
topics.reason: V4 accepts remaining and residue branches for the root, but local grammar selects a denied remaining entity or trace rather than all broader branches.

topics.headline: survivor, trace, and legacy all excluded
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial can cover living survivor, physical residue, enduring legacy, and ongoing trace, while the local phrase does not require choosing only one.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL sense range is compatible with the V4 remaining and residue branches; it is narrowed to locally denied remnant or trace values.

topics.headline: remaining thing, not abstract survival
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the form points to a concrete remaining instance rather than to survival as an abstract idea.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a feminine active participle, and the local phrase asks for an instance under the partitive frame.

topics.headline: limited active-participle form salience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the active-participle form is distributionally salient here, though it is not a hapax.
topics.reason: The contextual profile gives seven active-participle instances, so rarity survives as limited form salience rather than uniqueness.

topics.reason: The bundle explicitly recommends the preceding destruction scene as the reading window for the remnant question.

topics.reason: The contrast is coherent as cross-reference background, but local grammar does not require ayah-level integration.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The addressed verb at word 2 and the partitive-negative construction around word 5 make the scene an inspection for even one remainder.
baseline_models.mechanism: Eye-or-insight seeing searches a field for a remaining portion; hal plus min and an indefinite baqiya push the search down to the smallest surviving person, piece, or trace.

activation_trace.role: Seeing by eye or insight supplies the viewer's active inspection of the aftermath.
A remaining portion or residue supplies the minimal object the viewer is challenged to find.

changed_reading.before: A generic question asks whether anyone survived.
changed_reading.after: The addressee must inspect for even one residual person, portion, or visible trace belonging to them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same two focus words permit inward judgment about persistence, not only ocular detection of a body.
baseline_models.mechanism: Reflective seeing tests whether anything of them continues against perishing; the remaining candidate can be an effect or consequence rather than a living individual.

activation_trace.role: Reflective judgment turns seeing into an assessment of what still counts as present.
Persistence against perishing, including a remaining effect, widens the candidate beyond bodies.

changed_reading.before: Only a living survivor could answer the question.
changed_reading.after: The question can also deny any enduring effect, footprint, or consequence that could still be discerned as theirs.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The beneficiary phrase lahum and baqiya at word 5 allow remainder to be heard as something spared or held back for them.
baseline_models.mechanism: Instead of treating survival as accidental, the branch pair asks whether an agent preserved anyone by mercy or retained any stock or capacity in reserve.

activation_trace.role: Inspection asks whether any spared or reserved item is actually detectable.
Sparing and keeping alive contributes the possibility of a mercifully preserved person.
Holding back a reserve contributes stock, strength, or capacity intentionally left unused.

changed_reading.before: The question denies an accidental survivor.
changed_reading.after: It also asks whether any mercy, person, strength, or reserve was held back for them at all.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Seeing at word 2 and the watching-and-waiting branch of word 5 create a self-reinforcing observational loop.
baseline_models.mechanism: The viewer looks not only for what remains now but for anything still pending under observation, as though continued watching might disclose a delayed remainder.

activation_trace.role: Seeing supplies the active watcher.
Watching and waiting supplies a remainder whose status could still be pending rather than settled.

changed_reading.before: The question takes a static census of what is present.
changed_reading.after: It tests whether anything remains pending, awaited, or capable of appearing under continued watch.

context_deltas.mechanism: The named reality is made inspectable: a first act of seeing presents a people thrown down as the rear ends of hollow palms, and the repeated seeing in the focus verse scans that same visual field until even those residual forms disappear. Absence becomes demonstrative evidence, not merely reported destruction.

activation_trace.role: Eye-or-insight seeing anchors the renewed inspection in the focus question.
The remaining portion is the last possible evidence being sought.
Establishing and manifesting truth makes the visible aftermath function as a proved verdict.
The first second-person act of seeing opens the continuous visual field that 69:8 rescans.
Being thrown and fallen supplies the bodies' ground-level state.
The rear or end of a thing makes the bodies look like leftover terminal pieces.
The palm-tree image gives the apparent remains a concrete material form.
Collapse and ruin remove stability even from the forms that initially look residual.

structural_cues: 69:8 follows 69:7 with fa and repeats the second-person singular act of seeing.
The comparison supplies visible corpse-like forms before min plus an indefinite baqiya demands a search for even one remainder.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated seeing, fallen bodies, terminal palm forms, collapse, and manifest truth; I infer that the second scan converts visual absence into proof of the verdict. A live alternative is the simpler rhetorical denial of survivors without an evidentiary function.

changed_reading.before: The verse asks whether a survivor is visible.
changed_reading.after: It commands a second forensic scan in which the disappearance of even corpse-like residual forms visibly certifies total erasure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated proper name activates return and an aged stock that still carries residual strength. Against baqiya, the question can deny not only a survivor but any recurrence, regenerative return, or old reserve from which the people might rise again.

activation_trace.role: Persistence against perishing anchors the possibility of continuity or recurrence.
Return after departure contributes a possible cycle or reappearance that the focus question closes.
An aged stock with remnants of strength contributes the possibility of a residual capacity to recover.

structural_cues: The proper name recurs twice before the focus question.
The focus question closes the people's sequence with fa and an exhaustive indefinite remainder.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a QAC root cue for the proper name together with return and residual-strength branches; I infer a sound-and-root activation from the repeated name into baqiya. The materially live alternative is to treat the name solely as a proper noun and reject this layer.

changed_reading.before: No member of the named people remains alive.
changed_reading.after: No return, regenerative recurrence, or aged reserve of their collective life remains available.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated destruction, an overwhelming force, its directed subjugation, and an eradication-cut recast baqiya's sparing and reserve branches. The question denies both a remnant accidentally left by the force and any mercy or capacity deliberately held back from it.

activation_trace.role: Sparing and keeping alive makes survival a question of mercy rather than chance.
A held-back reserve supplies the possibility that destructive force conserved some stock or strength.
Falling into annihilation supplies the terminal result against which any sparing is tested.
An overwhelming punishment supplies force that exceeds ordinary bounds.
Subjugating and driving a thing toward a purpose makes the destructive force sustained and directed.
Eradication supplies the inference that no root-stock was left from which a remainder could persist.

structural_cues: Passive destruction is repeated for two peoples before a force is sustained over a measured span.
The focus question arrives only after the duration has run its complete course.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies annihilation, overwhelming force, directed use, and eradication; I infer an arrow from exhaustive operation to the denial of both mercy and reserve. An alternative keeps these cues as intensity only and hears baqiya as a simple survivor noun.

changed_reading.before: No one happened to survive the destructive event.
changed_reading.after: The operation left neither a person spared by mercy nor any conserved stock, strength, or root from which survival could resume.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later rescue sequence distinguishes a remnant for a people from a remainder transmitted to hearers: persons are carried, the event is made a reminder for you, and meaning is enclosed in a receptive ear. Material survival becomes mnemonic survival across a container chain.

activation_trace.role: Reflective seeing permits a remembered meaning, rather than a body, to count as a discernible remainder.
A continuing effect anchors memory as a genuine mode of remaining.
Carrying a visible load supplies the first preservation container in the sequence.
A reminder that causes recollection converts rescued history into an enduring cognitive residue.
Enclosing meaning in the heart supplies the inward vessel that preserves the event.
Attentive reception of what is heard supplies the transfer point from event to memory.

structural_cues: The pronouns shift from no remainder for them to a reminder made for you.
The sequence moves through nested carriers: vessel, reminder, receptive ear, and contained meaning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily carrying, reminder, receptive hearing, and containment of meaning; I infer that preservation can migrate from organism to memory. A live alternative is that the rescue narrative merely contrasts peoples and does not redefine baqiya.

changed_reading.before: Remainder means a body left after disaster.
changed_reading.after: Nothing remains for them as a living collective, yet the event can remain for later hearers as a carried and inwardly contained memory.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later display, the failure of anything hidden to stay hidden, and the paired visible and non-visible domains prevent the focus question from resting on ordinary eyesight alone. Seeing becomes judicial discernment within an exhaustive exposure regime.

activation_trace.role: Eye-or-insight seeing anchors both sensory inspection and broader discernment.
Any residual portion is the item that might otherwise escape notice.
Bringing something out for inspection supplies a formal display rather than casual looking.
Concealment supplies the possible hidden remainder that the clause explicitly disallows.
Ocular seeing names the visible half of the exhaustive evidentiary field.
Insight supplies access beyond the immediately visible when paired with what is not seen.

structural_cues: 69:18 states that no hidden item remains concealed during display.
69:38-39 form an explicit visible versus non-visible pair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies formal display, failed concealment, and paired domains of sight; I infer that the later disclosure regime retroactively expands tara beyond ordinary ocular evidence. An alternative keeps the historical aftermath and later judgment scenes epistemically separate.

changed_reading.before: The lack of a visible survivor settles the matter through normal eyesight.
changed_reading.after: The question tests whether any remainder, visible or hidden, can survive exhaustive disclosure and discerning judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Book, account, wealth, and authoritative claim form a ledger sequence. Because the focus remainder branch includes an outstanding balance and lahum marks allocation, baqiya can ask whether any credit, asset, entitlement, or argumentative remainder is still carried for them.

activation_trace.role: Reflective judgment supplies the act of auditing what still counts for them.
A remainder or outstanding balance directly supplies the ledger residue.
A written fixation that entails judgment supplies the binding record.
Counting and accounting supply the operation that determines a remainder.
Accumulated property supplies the asset that proves unable to leave a usable balance.
A compelling proof or claim supplies the last argumentative asset that also perishes.

structural_cues: Possessive forms for book, account, wealth, and authority accumulate around the two judgment outcomes.
The focus lahum similarly asks what, if anything, remains allocated to the destroyed group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies binding record, calculation, assets, and compelling claim, while the focus branch explicitly supplies an outstanding balance; I infer a ledger relation among them. The alternative is that these later possessions exemplify judgment without changing the earlier survivor sense.

changed_reading.before: Baqiya counts surviving persons or physical debris.
changed_reading.after: It can audit whether any credit, property, entitlement, defense, or unpaid balance remains on their side of the account.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later negations move through close kin, not even one person, and an intervening barrier or clan. Their syntax echoes lahum min baqiya, shifting the remainder from material debris toward the social relation of someone left for them who could shield, spare, or represent them.

activation_trace.role: Sparing and keeping alive anchors the need for an agent who might preserve them.
A categorical denial of the present state supplies the later social negation.
Close kinship supplies the absent intimate ally.
Exhaustive negation extends absence through every possible individual.
Interposition by a barrier supplies the protective function no remaining person can perform.
A man's origin or clan supplies the wider social body that also cannot intervene.

structural_cues: The sequence echoes focus lahum with later lahu and echoes min baqiya with min ahadin.
The singular intimate ally expands to exhaustive individuals and then to the function of interposition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies close kin, exhaustive negation, barrier, and clan; I infer that a 'remainder for them' can be relational, namely somebody still standing for them. A live alternative restricts baqiya to members of the destroyed people rather than protectors outside them.

changed_reading.before: The question asks whether any member of the group survived.
changed_reading.after: It also denies any surviving ally, kin group, representative, or barrier left for them who could interpose and secure sparing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later discourse distinguishes perception, messenger, meaningful saying, reminder, truth, and settled certainty. The destroyed people have no remainder for themselves, yet their disappearance generates a report that remains from them for other minds; bodily nullity becomes testimonial persistence.

activation_trace.role: Insight and reflective judgment anchor the receiving mind that can retain testimony.
A continuing effect anchors the report as a non-bodily remainder.
Heart-insight supplies perception of the report's significance beyond the vanished scene.
Messenger and message supply the authorized carrier of the surviving account.
A thing's signification makes the saying function as evidence rather than mere sound.
The reminder supplies explicit persistence in later receivers.
Truth fixed in correspondence with reality gives the report durable evidentiary status.
Stable knowledge after doubt supplies the report's settled reception.

structural_cues: The focus assigns no remainder to them, while later reminder and report language is directed toward receivers.
The closing sequence repeatedly predicates status of the discourse with innahu, moving persistence from people to message.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies perception, authorized message, signifying speech, reminder, truth, and certainty; I infer that the account persists precisely because the people do not. An alternative takes the reminder as the whole revelation without a special relation to their erased remainder.

changed_reading.before: Nothing at all remains of the people.
changed_reading.after: Nothing remains for them, but a true and cognitively effective report remains from them for later perceivers.

context_deltas.mechanism: Severance, the vital artery, and exhausted strength model survival as a line of continuity rather than a headcount. Applied back to baqiya, total destruction means the line that could carry life forward has been cut at its source and has no residual force.

activation_trace.role: Persistence against extinction anchors continuity as the object denied.
Severing and separation supply the decisive break in continuity.
Cessation, disappearance, and end supply the temporal result of the break.
The artery of life supplies the material conduit whose loss ends organismic continuation.
Strength cut off and exhausted supplies the absence of residual capacity after severance.

structural_cues: The later conditional moves with thumma from taking to cutting the vital conduit.
The focus indefinite remainder can denote continuity or capacity as well as an individual.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a severed vital conduit, resulting end, and exhausted strength; I infer that collective survival can be modeled as transmissible life continuity. An alternative confines the later anatomy to its immediate conditional subject and leaves 69:8 as a census.

changed_reading.before: No individual survivor can be seen.
changed_reading.after: No line of life, generative continuity, or residual force remains through which the collective could continue.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant ر و ي mapping of the focus seeing root and later poetry/divination contrasts, so it is form-distant from the ordinary syntax. It remains valid as an activation because the focus inventory itself supplies narration, residual debt, and rhyme while baqiya supplies remainder, and the later context explicitly sorts kinds of transmitted speech. Downstream prose should call it a metatextual echo, never a lexical translation of tara.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins a split-mapped seeing verb whose non-dominant inventory includes narrated report and residue to an explicit remaining portion at word 5.

activation_trace.role: Transmission of reports and poetry lets the act of seeing echo, form-distantly, as receiving their narrated account.
A remaining debt or residue doubles the explicit remainder in baqiya and gives the echo material traction.
The remaining portion anchors the outlier in the focus predicate rather than in speech themes alone.
Uttered speech supplies the medium in which a vanished people can still have a trace.
Poetic composition supplies one explicitly rejected classification of the surviving verbal form.
A diviner's hidden reports supply the second rejected channel of transmission.
Delivering something down to recipients supplies the affirmed channel by which the account persists.

changed_reading.before: Their bodily population leaves no remainder.
changed_reading.after: Their only residue may be the narrated and rhythmically carried account of their disappearance, with its transmission classified as revelation rather than poetry or divination.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is unusually branch-distant because it links the focus seeing inventory's menstrual trace with the later reading root's menstrual-cycle branch. It remains anchored in the focus act of seeing and explicit residue, and the shared function is forensic distinction between an ongoing condition and completed cessation. Downstream prose should present it only as a trace-detection material analogy, not as a claim that either surface word bears this sense here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A specialized trace detectable by seeing at word 2 combines with the residual portion at word 5 to ask what sign could distinguish continuation from complete ending.

activation_trace.role: A trace used to distinguish menstruation from purity supplies a concrete forensic sign read from residue.
Residual matter anchors the sign as something actually left behind.
The interval of menstruation and purity supplies a second branch-level cycle whose state is known by traces.

changed_reading.before: The viewer merely counts surviving bodies.
changed_reading.after: The viewer performs a forensic test for any residual sign that would distinguish ongoing collective life from a cleanly completed cessation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because later fruit-picking and eating imagery is transferred backward into the wind-stripped palm scene. It remains anchored in the focus search for a visible residue and in the packet's palm, fallen gleaning, and consumption branches. Downstream prose should qualify it as an ecological and material analogy for exhaustive removal, not a historical detail or lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Seeing at word 2 searches for a remaining portion at word 5, allowing the destroyed palm-like scene to be tested for even a gleaning.

activation_trace.role: Ocular inspection supplies the search across a stripped material field.
A leftover portion supplies the possible gleaning.
The palm tree supplies the grove-like material substrate for the analogy.
What falls from picking supplies the expected leftover or gleaning after harvest.
Consumption supplies the removal process that can leave, or fail to leave, a residue.

changed_reading.before: The wind leaves no surviving person.
changed_reading.after: The destruction resembles an exhausted harvest of a palm-like field from which not even a fallen gleaning remains.

strongest_changes: Repeated seeing turns the question into a forensic rescan whose empty result visibly proves the verdict.
The rescue-reminder-ear sequence relocates remainder from surviving bodies to carried memory.
Display, failed concealment, and visible versus non-visible perception expand seeing into exhaustive judicial disclosure.
Book and account language activates baqiya's outstanding-balance sense, while later kin and barrier negations activate a relational protector sense.
The closing message can remain from those for whom no bodily remainder remains.
summary.what_was_special: The focus contains several internal feedback loops: seeing meets a remainder branch that itself means watching, sparing meets total eradication, and the non-dominant ر و ي mapping places narration and residue inside the seeing root. Context then repeatedly moves preservation across domains, from body to reserve, memory, account, social protection, life conduit, and true report, without forcing those readings into one answer.
remaining_uncertainties: Baqiya's immediate grammar most naturally supports a survivor or remainder; spared reserve, ledger balance, and life-continuity readings depend on branch activation rather than direct disambiguation.
The proper-name return model and every use of the non-dominant ر و ي mapping remain intentionally form-distant.
Later disclosure and judgment scenes may revise the epistemology of 69:8, or they may remain separate scenes that only echo it retrospectively.
The forensic-cycle and exhausted-harvest outliers are coherent material analogies but should not be promoted to lexical senses.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A forensic search for residue.** **ب ق ي B002** (remaining portion or residue) is governed by **ر ء ي B001** (seeing by eye or insight). The packet supplies the preceding debris field and the visual question; I infer that sight is tasked with testing whether any social or material remainder survives. The ayah reads as evidentiary verification of totality.
2. **The cancellation of sparing.** **ب ق ي B003** (sparing and keeping alive) is negatively activated by `من باقية` and contrasts with the carried survivors in 69:11. The packet supplies annihilation here and preservation there; I infer that the question can ask whether anyone was spared, not only whether an object remains. This preserves residue and survivor readings as distinct but co-present.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 69:11's carried passengers make **ب ق ي B003** newly audible: the question tests whether anyone was spared, not only whether debris remained.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Seeing is made to verify an absence.** `ر ء ي` B001 is "seeing by eye or insight" and B012 is "showing and making seen." The previous `فَتَرَى` displays fallen bodies; the present `فَهَلْ تَرَىٰ` asks the addressee to inspect for what is not there. B001 supplies the inspection, while the repeated second-person construction gives B012 a demonstrative role. The packet supplies visible remains followed by an absent remainder; I infer that the contrast trains sight to treat absence as evidence. The question reads as a public verification procedure, not only as rhetorical emphasis.
2. **No survivor, yet a remainder is deliberately preserved.** `ب ق ي` B002 is a "remaining portion or residue," B003 is "sparing and keeping alive," and B004 is "holding back a reserve." The immediate question denies all three at the level of the destroyed people, but 69:11 carries another human line in the vessel and 69:12 turns that event into `تَذْكِرَةً`. The branches assign different possible remainders: biological survivor, held reserve, and memorial residue. The packet supplies extinction on one side and carried memory on the other; I infer a correction from no remainder whatsoever to no remainder *for them*, while testimony is preserved elsewhere. The ayah becomes a precise distinction between failed communal survival and successful mnemonic survival.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 69:48's second `تَذْكِرَةٌ` confirms the correction first glimpsed in 69:12: no `بَاقِيَةٍ` survives for the destroyed group, yet an admonitory residue persists to the surah's end. `ب ق ي` B002 is thus activated negatively for bodies but positively at the level of testimony. The late `حَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ` in 69:51 adds that what remains is not mere cultural memory but a truth-claim kept firm.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Eye, inward judgment, dream, mutual facing, mirror-image, induced showing, and the interrogative call to report all organize modes of inspection. Concealment is removed rather than merely denied: a faint flash emerges from cloud, an object is displayed, and even indirect wording has an outer and inner face to be read.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Air carries life, cold, and summons
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Moving air can animate, overpower, cool, voice, inflate, or leave a body at the moment of death.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: One medium joins meteorology and physiology: gale, scent, lung, panting, hiccup, roar, and the final departing breath.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Breath, lung, inflation, and final exhalation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Air enters and leaves living bodies, expands tissue, strains respiration, and marks the loss of life.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: النفس والروح التي بها حياة البدن (`quranic:root_000609:B001/m01`); الراحة والاستراحة والإراحة (`quranic:root_000609:B007/m01`); الموت بلفظ الإراحة (`quranic:root_000609:B016/m01`); الرئة وما يصيبها (`quranic:root_000531:B009/m01`); إرسال الريح في الشيء (`quranic:root_001529:B001/m01`); انتفاخ الشيء وامتلاؤه بالريح (`quranic:root_001529:B002/m01`); انتفاخ الفخر والكبر (`quranic:root_001529:B006/m01`); تصعد النفس وانتفاخه (`quranic:root_000537:B004/m01`); فواق الصدر والنزع (`quranic:root_001188:B010/m01`); عرض الإنسان حماه وبدنه وظاهر وجهه (`quranic:root_001001:B009/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Spirit, lung, inhaled or expelled air, swelling, proud inflation, panting, hiccup, and the death-rattle occupy one respiratory mechanism. Rest is the recovery of breath, while death is its terminal release; even social pride is materialized as a body puffed beyond its proper measure.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Vertical forms are hollowed, split, and leveled
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Tall bodies, palms, buildings, mountains, and sky lose their interior support and vertical distinction.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Ruin is rendered through carpentry and anatomy: empty belly, uprooted trunk, loosened wall, torn skin, buried well, and sand ridge all undergo related structural failure.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Barren vacancy after failed rain
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Rain misses or withdraws, growth fails, and place becomes empty, exposed, and lethal to a traveler.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: أرض مأفوكة صرف عنها المطر (`quranic:root_000041:B005/m01`); أرض أخطأها المطر (`quranic:root_000420:B003/m01`); أرض هلكين لا غيث فيها (`quranic:root_001596:B005/m01`); مهواة ومفازة مهلكة (`quranic:root_001596:B006/m01`); إخلاف النوء (`quranic:root_000450:B003/m01`); خواء الجوف (`quranic:root_000450:B005/m01`); قرع وانكشاف وخلو (`quranic:root_001219:B008/m01`); دوام الشيء وبقاؤه (`quranic:root_000142:B001/m01`); البقية وما يبقى من الشيء (`quranic:root_000142:B002/m01`); الإبقاء عفوا واستحياء (`quranic:root_000142:B003/m01`); حبس بعض الشيء وادخاره (`quranic:root_000142:B004/m01`); يبس الشجر (`quranic:root_000217:B008/m01`); ما بالدار نافخ ضرمة (`quranic:root_001529:B005/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: A rainless, burned tract and a star-season that yields no water lead to hollow bellies, dead wood, stripped enclosures, an empty house, and a killing waste. Against that extinction, remaining, remnant, mercy, and saved reserve become sharply material counter-images: survival is what has not been stripped out of the place.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Flood becomes conveyance and controlled water
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Water moves from excess to transport, capture, storage, and measured delivery.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The flood scene opens into hydraulic engineering: channels, catch basins, wells, receiving hands, cloud-reservoirs, and reflective coatings.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Watered sheen, plating, and reflected appearance
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A thin liquid-like surface changes how metal, face, fruit, or stone appears to an observer.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: كسوة المعدن بماء الذهب أو الفضة (`quranic:root_001458:B005/m01`); رونق كالماء في الوجه والكلام والثمر (`quranic:root_001458:B006/m01`); صفاء الماوية كالبلور والمرآة (`quranic:root_001458:B007/m01`); مرأى ومنظر ومرآة (`quranic:root_000531:B006/m01`); لمع البرق الخفي (`quranic:root_000428:B004/m01`); الصورة والهيئة المصورة (`quranic:root_000891:B003/m01`); العارض البادي من جهة (`quranic:root_001001:B003/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Metal plating can disguise its substrate, while watery brightness gives face, speech, fruit, crystal, and mirror their sheen. Reflection, faint lightning, formed image, and a distant appearing mass make appearance a surface event whose truth depends on what lies beneath.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: A message is sent, heard, and kept
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Communication is a custody chain in which a charge is dispatched, carried, received, retained, and made recallable.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The communication chain is materialized as herd after herd, flowing provision, a carried burden, an inward vessel, a legal deed, and an ear that acts as a gate of permission.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Spoken name, reputation, and public recurrence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Repeated speech makes a person or event present in communal memory as name, fame, praise, or blame.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: جريان الذكر على اللسان (`quranic:root_000516:B004/m01`); ذكر المرء شرف وصيت (`quranic:root_000516:B007/m01`); الاسم تنويه ودلالة (`quranic:root_000745:B005/m01`); الصيت الحسن المنتشر (`quranic:root_000745:B008/m01`); رياء الناس (`quranic:root_000531:B005/m01`); الرسول والرسالة (`quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`); استقامة واعتدال واستواء (`quranic:root_001273:B008/m01`); ردع يقرع السامع (`quranic:root_001219:B006/m01`); الجَعْلة اسم مكان (`quranic:root_000248:B011/m01`); العلم بموضع أو يوم (`quranic:root_000450:B008/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Tongued mention and carried message give a name public reach; favorable renown can rise, while place-name and named day stabilize reference. Performance for spectators and rebuke expose distorted social uses of visibility, and straight speech supplies the norm by which praise, blame, and reputation are heard.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Falsehood redirects signs and surfaces
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Misrepresentation works by attributing what is not so, coating reality with a misleading surface, or turning perception away from its proper object.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Falsehood reaches bodily motion and materials: milk promises continuity then stops, an animal runs then checks, cloth lies by its colors, metal is plated, and a charm turns a face.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: False report, attribution, and inward self-deception
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A speaker or community asserts what is contrary to fact, assigns the lie to another, or houses deception in the self.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: خلاف الصدق (`quranic:root_001290:B001/m01`); نسبة الشيء أو صاحبه إلى الكذب (`quranic:root_001290:B002/m01`); النفس الكذوب (`quranic:root_001290:B008/m01`); الإفك كذب مصروف عن الصدق (`quranic:root_000041:B002/m01`); عقل مأفوك وحيلة مصروفة (`quranic:root_000041:B006/m01`); ردع يقرع السامع (`quranic:root_001219:B006/m01`); رياء الناس (`quranic:root_000531:B005/m01`); الوقيعة في الناس (`quranic:root_001675:B013/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Lie, accusation of lying, deceptive self, turned judgment, and backbiting form a single testimonial failure. Public performance seeks witnesses rather than truth, while rebuke presses the hearer to reverse direction and re-enter truthful judgment.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Falsehood redirects signs and surfaces
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Misrepresentation works by attributing what is not so, coating reality with a misleading surface, or turning perception away from its proper object.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Falsehood reaches bodily motion and materials: milk promises continuity then stops, an animal runs then checks, cloth lies by its colors, metal is plated, and a charm turns a face.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Painted cloth, plated metal, and turning charm
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A fabricated outer appearance induces an observer or target to take one thing for another.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: الكذابة ثوب يكذب بحاله (`quranic:root_001290:B009/m01`); كسوة المعدن بماء الذهب أو الفضة (`quranic:root_001458:B005/m01`); خرزة تقبل وجها إلى وجه (`quranic:root_001198:B016/m01`); رقية تمسك وتحبس (`quranic:root_000018:B004/m01`); مرأى ومنظر ومرآة (`quranic:root_000531:B006/m01`); رئي من الجن (`quranic:root_000531:B008/m01`); الصورة والهيئة المصورة (`quranic:root_000891:B003/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Multicolored cloth 'lies' by its state, plating presents base metal as precious, and a bead or binding charm turns attention and action. Mirror-image and a presenting spirit supply receivers for that manufactured appearance; formed shape can be mentally real while materially misleading.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Falsehood redirects signs and surfaces

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Promised continuation that abruptly fails
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An action appears likely to persist but stops, delays, or proves unable to complete its course.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: ما كذب أن فعل أي ما لبث (`quranic:root_001290:B005/m01`); كذب لبن الناقة إذا ذهب ولم يدم (`quranic:root_001290:B006/m01`); كذب الوحشي إذا جرى ثم وقف (`quranic:root_001290:B007/m01`); سكوت لا يبدئ ولا يعيد (`quranic:root_001058:B003/m01`); ضعف وقصور عن الفعل (`quranic:root_000985:B001/m01`); فوت وسبق وإفلات من الطلب (`quranic:root_000985:B002/m01`); جمود ووقوف وكلال (`quranic:root_001273:B016/m01`); ترقب الشيء وانتظاره بالبصر (`quranic:root_000142:B005/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Immediate action can belie delay, milk can belie expected duration, and a running animal can halt to look back. Speechlessness, incapacity, escape, and a stalled mount turn failed continuation into a bodily scene; watchful waiting measures the gap between expectation and arrival.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Sovereignty rests on raised supports
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Rule is sustained by a hierarchy of throne, upper position, structural mainstay, delegated care, and communal covenant.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Royal elevation is tested through architecture and husbandry: a throne may be broken, a roof propped, a well timbered, a flock led, and a polity maintained by water and covenant.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Cultivation, custody, and delegated care
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A responsible agent maintains dependents, property, and resources until they reach a sound state.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: إصلاح وتربية وإتمام (`quranic:root_000532:B002/m01`); ربيب وربيبة ورابة (`quranic:root_000532:B005/m01`); لزوم وإقامة ودوام (`quranic:root_000532:B007/m01`); شاة رُبّى وحداثة (`quranic:root_000532:B009/m01`); قوة الشيء وتماسكه (`quranic:root_001444:B001/m01`); مِلاك الأمر وعِماده (`quranic:root_001444:B005/m01`); الماء مَلَك الأمر (`quranic:root_001444:B007/m01`); رعاية وحفظ وولاية (`quranic:root_001273:B004/m01`); نيابة وقيام مقام غيره (`quranic:root_001273:B007/m01`); الحمالة والكفالة (`quranic:root_000357:B004/m01`); الحميل المحمول في النسب (`quranic:root_000357:B005/m01`); الإبقاء عفوا واستحياء (`quranic:root_000142:B003/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Gradual upbringing, care for a stepchild, settled attendance, and a ewe kept near the house show rule as maintenance. Coherence, mainstay, water supply, substitution, guarantee, care for an unverified dependent, and merciful preservation all ask whether authority keeps what has been entrusted to it.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Herd life follows generation, movement, and equipment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Animal life is organized through mating, gestation, maturation, herd circulation, milking intervals, shelter, and predation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The lexical network turns abstract completion and return into a full pastoral economy, from conception and birth through age, watering, tack, shelter, and the hunter's blind.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Mating, conception, and approaching birth
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Male and female animals meet, conception becomes visible, and a carried young approaches emergence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: ناقة بلغت حق الحمل والانتفاع (`quranic:root_000347:B008/m01`); تمام حال الحيوان وقوته (`quranic:root_000347:B013/m01`); أحق من الخيل يطابق خطوه أو يشتد بدنه (`quranic:root_000347:B014/m01`); ضراب الفحل وإنزاؤه (`quranic:root_001219:B003/m01`); ظهور حمل الناقة أو الشاة (`quranic:root_000531:B010/m01`); تحصن الفرس وصيرورته فحلا (`quranic:root_000609:B018/m01`); الحَمْل الباطن والثمر (`quranic:root_000357:B002/m01`); الحَمَل من الضأن (`quranic:root_000357:B009/m01`); ماء الفحل في الرحم (`quranic:root_001458:B004/m01`); اشتهاء الأنثى للفحل (`quranic:root_000248:B009/m01`); فرخ النعام (`quranic:root_000248:B010/m01`); الحامل تدنو ولادتها (`quranic:root_000548:B005/m01`); رفع الحمار رأسه عند الحمل (`quranic:root_001000:B009/m01`); تغذية ونشوء (`quranic:root_000537:B005/m01`); انتفاخ الشيء وامتلاؤه بالريح (`quranic:root_001529:B002/m01`); الطغيا الصغير من بقر الوحش (`quranic:root_000936:B009/m01`); تطاول الفحل على الشول (`quranic:root_000745:B003/m01`); إلقاء الثقل في المخالطة (`quranic:root_000482:B009/m01`); المواقعة في الجماع (`quranic:root_001675:B014/m01`); ترية الحيض (`quranic:root_000531:B007/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Breeding readiness, mounting, deposited seed, visible pregnancy, inward burden, swelling, menstrual sign, and the nearness of birth form a continuous generational scene. A stallion rising over mares and bodily weight in intercourse make coupling explicit; young camel, lamb, ostrich chick, and wild-cattle calf mark successive products. The `ط غ و` calf motif has no available surface-root anchor.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Herd life follows generation, movement, and equipment

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A hunter conceals approach, marks the target, and confronts predatory taking.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: السبع الحيوان المفترس (`quranic:root_000669:B002/m01`); الوقيعة والاغتياب كأذى السبع (`quranic:root_000669:B003/m01`); فعل سبعة: المبالغة في الأخذ والشر (`quranic:root_000669:B005/m01`); الختل والاستتار للصيد (`quranic:root_000473:B003/m01`); المدرى والحد المحدد (`quranic:root_000473:B004/m01`); رئي من الجن (`quranic:root_000531:B008/m01`); راية منصوبة (`quranic:root_000531:B011/m01`); الخروج للصيد (`quranic:root_000745:B006/m01`); قطيع البقر (`quranic:root_000891:B006/m01`); الطغيا الصغير من بقر الوحش (`quranic:root_000936:B009/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: `س ب ع`: 69:7 (سَبْعَ); `د ر ي`: 69:3 (أَدْرَىٰ); `ر ء ي`: 69:7 (تَرَى), 69:8 (تَرَىٰ); `س م و`: 69:16 (سَّمَآءُ); `ص و ر`: 69:13 (صُّورِ); `ط غ و`: unavailable (surface root missing)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Beast, mauling insult, and exemplary ferocity establish predation. The hunter hides behind a mount, uses a pointed tool, follows a spirit-sign or raised standard, and goes out after quarry; a cattle herd and wild calf supply the visible target. The `ط غ و` calf remains lexically supported but surface-unanchored.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Plants are raised, selected, and made valuable
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Cultivation converts water and soil into growth, then separates, selects, stores, and values the product.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Palm trunks open onto seedbed, cloud, sap, sieve, jewelry, market, and reserved running strength rather than remaining a single botanical emblem.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Sifting, choosing, reserving, and pricing
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A harvest or stock is separated so that the best portion can be saved, displayed, and assigned value.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: تصفية الدقيق بالمنخل (`quranic:root_001483:B002/m01`); اختيار الأفضل (`quranic:root_001483:B003/m01`); تنخيل الثلج والودق (`quranic:root_001483:B004/m01`); مقروع مختار وخيار (`quranic:root_001219:B007/m01`); العوض والقيمة في البيع (`quranic:root_000206:B001/m01`); قيمة وتقويم وتسعير (`quranic:root_001273:B010/m01`); نفاق السوق (`quranic:root_001273:B018/m01`); حبس بعض الشيء وادخاره (`quranic:root_000142:B004/m01`); تمام حال الحيوان وقوته (`quranic:root_000347:B013/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Sieving separates flour and bran; selection extracts the best; falling rain or snow is imagined through the same perforated motion. Choice stock, price, appraisal, active market, reserved running power, and finished fatness continue the operation from processing into exchange.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Community is sustained by kin care and exchange
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Groups endure through lineage, guardianship, gift, valuation, labor, and the circulation of benefit.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The social body includes outsider, foundling, stepchild, elder, clan, guarantor, wage, tribute, market, and returning favor.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Stepchild, foundling, guarantor, and merciful preservation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Care is extended to a dependent whose safety, lineage, or claim requires another to stand for them.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: إصلاح وتربية وإتمام (`quranic:root_000532:B002/m01`); ربيب وربيبة ورابة (`quranic:root_000532:B005/m01`); شاة رُبّى وحداثة (`quranic:root_000532:B009/m01`); تلقي الخارج إلى اليد (`quranic:root_001198:B007/m01`); ضمان الشيء والتكفل به (`quranic:root_001198:B008/m01`); الحمالة والكفالة (`quranic:root_000357:B004/m01`); الحميل المحمول في النسب (`quranic:root_000357:B005/m01`); عيادة ومعادة وزيارة راجعة (`quranic:root_001058:B005/m01`); عائدة ومعروف يرجع (`quranic:root_001058:B006/m01`); رد الحق إلى صاحبه (`quranic:root_000609:B006/m01`); الإبقاء عفوا واستحياء (`quranic:root_000142:B003/m01`); القائم على اليتيم (`quranic:root_001664:B007/m01`); الفاقة حاجة وفقر (`quranic:root_001188:B011/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Upbringing, stepchild, house-kept ewe, birth attendant, guarantor, indemnity, foundling, sick-visit, returning favor, restored right, mercy, poverty, and orphan guardian form a care network. The invariant is not sentiment alone but taking responsibility for another's continuity.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Community is sustained by kin care and exchange

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Marriage, courtship, and household transition
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A woman moves between youth, courtship, marriage, separation, and renewed social attachment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: الجارية من النساء وصباها (`quranic:root_000240:B004/m01`); الاستئناس والانبساط (`quranic:root_000563:B007/m01`); المرأة المراسل (`quranic:root_000563:B009/m01`); الإملاك والتزويج (`quranic:root_001444:B004/m01`); أهل البيت من بني الأعمام (`quranic:root_000537:B007/m01`); ترية الحيض (`quranic:root_000531:B007/m01`); إلقاء الثقل في المخالطة (`quranic:root_000482:B009/m01`); المواقعة في الجماع (`quranic:root_001675:B014/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Young woman, social familiarity, courted widow or divorcee, marriage contract, cousins, menstrual sign, sexual weight, and intercourse describe household formation through bodily and legal transitions. The scene keeps gendered life distinct from the pastoral breeding channel even where operations resonate.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, görmeyi hem gözle algılama hem de gözün işlevine benzetilen içsel kavrayış olarak kuruyor. Doğrudan göz tanıklığı bu çekirdeğin duyusal gerçekleşimidir; zihinsel görüş, uyku düşü ve başkalarına görünme amacı bu dalın dışında kalır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği görsel ya da içsel algıdır; belirli söz öbekleri ve bakma çabası ayrı kullanımlar olarak tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın görme çekirdeği ile doğrudan göz tanıklığını ve görmeye çalışma bildiren bağlı kullanımlar birbirine karıştırılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi gözle ya da göz işlevi gören içsel kavrayışla algılamaktır. Gözün eriştiği yerde doğrudan görme, bu anlamın duyusal ve tanıklığa dayalı gerçekleşimidir.

facets.statement: Görülebilir bir şeyi gözle veya benzer bir içsel kavrayışla algılama.
Bir şeyi gözün eriştiği yerde doğrudan ve tanık olarak görme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, gözle görmeyi temel alır ve bazı anlatımlarda bu algıyı içsel kavrayışa kadar genişletir; doğrudan göz tanıklığı özellikle belirtilir.

concept_gloss.text: gözle ya da içsel kavrayışla görme

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ortak ekseni, bir konu hakkında zihinsel bir yargı veya görüş oluşturmaktır. Bilme ya da sanma değeri belirli tümce yapılarında, danışma ise başka birinin görüşünü istemede ortaya çıkar; bunlar yalın çekirdeğin eş düzeyli anlamları sayılmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Görüş, kanı ve düşünerek karar verme çekirdektir; bilme, sanma ve danışma yapıya bağlı gerçekleşimlerdir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın zihinsel yargı ile düşünme, danışma ve göz tanıklığına bağlı sanma kullanımları ayrı kapsamlarla gösterilir.

concept_map.definition: Bir konu hakkında düşünüp zihinde bir görüş, kanı veya yargı oluşturmaktır. Derinlemesine düşünme bu sonuca götüren süreçtir; danışma başka birinin yargısını isteme, belirli tümce yapılarıysa bilme ya da sanma değeridir.

facets.statement: Bir konu hakkında zihinde görüş, kanı veya yargı oluşturma.

Başka birinden görüş isteme veya belirli bir yapıda bilme ve sanma bildirme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar zihinsel görüş ve inancı ortaklaştırır; düşünerek görüşe varma, bir başkasına danışma ve belirli yapılardaki bilme ya da sanma değerleri bu eksenin bağlı gerçekleşimleridir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi açıkça uyuyan kişinin uykuda gördüğü şeyi ve bunun çoğulunu bildirir. Uyanıkken gözle görmek, zihinsel görüş ve düşü yorumlama bu kimliğin parçası değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca uyku sırasında görülen düşü adlandırır; uyanık algı ve yorumlama ayrı tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın dal uyku sırasında görülen düş anlamıyla sınırlıdır ve başka yapılara bağlı anlamlar buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Uyuyan bir kişinin uyku sırasında gördüğü düş veya düş görüntüsüdür. Adın çoğul biçimi de aynı türden birden çok uyku deneyimini bildirir.

facets.statement: Uyku sırasında görülen düş veya görüntü.
Aynı uyku deneyiminin tekil ve çoğul adlandırmaları.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dalı uyku sırasında görülen düş olarak tanımlar ve tekil adın birden çok düşü bildiren çoğul biçimini de kaydeder.

concept_gloss.applicability: Uyuyan kişinin gördüğü tek bir düşü veya genel olarak bu uyku deneyimini anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Uyku koşulunu ve görülen düş içeriğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Uyku sırasında bir görüntü veya olay dizisi yaşama eylemi anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Uyku içindeki görsel ya da yaşantısal deneyimi doğal Türkçeyle korur.
Göz önünde beliren bir görüntü düşüncesini korur.
error_profile.adds: Uyku dışında sezgi, tasarım veya uyanık görüntü anlamlarını da çağırır.
error_profile.collision: Uyanık görme ve zihinsel kavrayışla karışabilir.
